description:
Nevron Open Vision for .NET is a suite of advanced UI components and controls that helps you develop feature-rich Web (Blazor WebAssenbly) and Desktop (WinForms, WPF, Mac) applications from a single code base. The suite includes:
* UI Controls - buttons, check boxes, labels, date pickers, color pickers, ribbon, menus, toolbars, navigation bars and many more UI controls.
* UI Themes - Windows 11, Windows 10, Windows 8, Windows 7, Windows XP and Windows Classic, Mac, Light, Dark and many more UI themes.
* Chart - supports 100+ 2D and 3D charting types.
* Gauge - radial and linear gauges, led displays and state indicators multiple gauge areas and gauge combinations.
* Diagram - includes thousands of predefined shapes and Visio drawings (VSDX) and stencils (VSSX) import and export.
* Map - supports different map projections and includes ESRI shapefile import and export.
* Rich Text Editor - embed state-of-art, Microsoft Word-like abilities in your .NET applications. Includes Word (DOCX), RTF and HTML import and export.
* Schedule - easily embed the features of Outlook Calendar and Google Calendar in your applications. Includes iCalendar (ICAL) format import and export.
* Barcode - supports 28 linear (EAN-13, UPC, Code 39, Code 128, ISBN, etc.) and 3 matrix barcode symbologies (QR Code, Data Matrix and PDF-417).
* Grid - a high performance Data Grid component for displaying and editing tabular data.

For more information visit:
https://www.nevron.com/dotnet-controls

Documentation available at:
https://helpopenvision.nevron.com/

Blazor WebAssembly online demo:
https://blazorexamples.nevron.com/
